corrections.translation: ⟦0⟧. The cheetah, the animal sprint champion, can reach ⟦1⟧ km/h. At this speed, how many kilometres can it run per minute on average? (Round to two decimal places.)

The digits that repeat over and over in a repeating decimal are called its repeating part. A repeating decimal can be written with just one repeating part, with a dot above its first and last digits. For example: 0.666… is written as 0.6, 3.2727… as 3.27, and 0.1875875… as 0.1875. Can you write 24.333… and 0.85454… this way?
